in_marathi.name: Devenika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devenika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi (goddess) + Eka (one) + Nikā (prosperity). The name Devenika signifies the goddess of prosperity who is believed to bless her devotees with wealth and happiness.
